name: RangeSlider
description: A single or dual-thumb slider with a gradient-filled track, thumbs that glide to keyboard steps and swell while dragged, and a value tooltip that springs up above the active thumb.
a11yNotes: Implements the WAI-ARIA slider (and multi-thumb slider) pattern: each thumb is a focusable role="slider" with aria-valuenow, aria-valuetext (formatted with prefix/suffix) and aria-valuemin/max that follow the other thumb in range mode, so thumbs cannot cross. Single sliders are labelled by the visible label; range thumbs are named 'Minimum <label>' / 'Maximum <label>'. Arrow keys step, PageUp/PageDown take 10% steps, Home/End jump to the bounds. Clicking the track moves the nearest thumb and focuses it. The tooltip and readout are aria-hidden duplicates. Under prefers-reduced-motion thumbs and fill move without easing and the tooltip only fades.

propsApi.name: value
propsApi.description: Controlled values: one number for a single thumb, two for a range.

propsApi.name: onValueCommit
propsApi.description: Called when a drag ends or after a key step.

propsApi.name: range
propsApi.description: Render two thumbs (a range) instead of one.

propsApi.name: step
propsApi.description: Step increment; values snap to it.

propsApi.name: suffix
propsApi.description: Text after each formatted value, e.g. '%'.

propsApi.name: tooltip
propsApi.description: Show the value tooltip always, only on hover/focus/drag, or never.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Fill, thumb ring and tooltip color.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
